changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'integration' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionAssetTypeError') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [integration].[ExecutionAssetTypeError]( [ExecutionID] [bigint] NOT NULL, [SynchedAssetTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [SourceID] [varchar](100) NOT NULL, [ErrorMessages] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [Uid] [uniqueidentifier] CONSTRAINT [DF_IntegrationExecutionAssetTypeError_Uid] DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL, [ErrorCode] [int] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_IntegrationExecutionAssetTypeError] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [Uid] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_IntegrationExecutionAssetTypeError_IntegrationExecutionAssetType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [integration].[ExecutionAssetTypeError] WITH NOCHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_IntegrationExecutionAssetTypeError_IntegrationExecutionAssetType] FOREIGN KEY([ExecutionID], [SynchedAssetTypeID]) REFERENCES [integration].[ExecutionAssetType] ([ExecutionID], [SynchedAssetTypeID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [integration].[ExecutionAssetTypeError] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_IntegrationExecutionAssetTypeError_IntegrationExecutionAssetType] END
